ranked_facts.why: Weight loss of 17 pounds in 1 month is more characteristic of neoplastic disorders like Pancoast tumor, which is a type of lung cancer that can cause significant weight loss, than of inflammatory, vascular, or traumatic/compressive disorders.

Lower brachial plexus deficit, as indicated by C8-T1 hand weakness, is a characteristic finding in Pancoast tumor due to its location at the lung apex and potential to invade the brachial plexus, distinguishing it from other candidate conditions.
